import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected="6e39cbcd7f1c3ca8f0ebfac6a2b9d6b2948a1b58"

def run(args):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout

head=run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).strip()
status=run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).strip()
if head != expected or status:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected isolated state head={head} status={status!r}")

for rel in [
    "src/do_again/cli.py",
    "src/do_again/core/agent.py",
    "src/do_again/core/executor.py",
    "src/do_again/service/runtime.py",
]:
    p=wt/rel
    print(f"=== {rel} ===")
    lines=p.read_text().splitlines()
    keys=[
        "def doctor", "def status", "def history", "def trace", "def retry", "def cancel",
        "ledger", "receipt", "request", "log", "state/", "runtime_layout",
        "blocked_ambiguous_replay", "claim", "cancelled", "retry"
    ]
    hits=[]
    for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
        if any(k in line.lower() for k in [x.lower() for x in keys]):
            hits.append(i)
    # print merged small windows around first ~30 meaningful hits
    seen=set()
    for i in hits[:35]:
        start=max(1,i-5); end=min(len(lines),i+18)
        if any(n in seen for n in range(start,end+1)):
            continue
        seen.update(range(start,end+1))
        print(f"--- {start}-{end} ---")
        for n in range(start,end+1):
            print(f"{n:04d}: {lines[n-1]}")

print("=== tests mentioning diagnostics ===")
proc=subprocess.run(
    ["git","grep","-ni","doctor\|history\|trace\|logs\|retry\|cancel"],
    cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True
)
print(proc.stdout)
